findings.verifierReasoning: The source expressly makes the cap aggregate across clauses (i) and (ii). This means payments under both sub-clauses consume the same $25,000,000 annual basket. The proposed IR, as compiled, has no corresponding rule for clause (b)(i), no ledger/definition setting the shared cap, and no dependency tying the two sub-clauses together. A reader could therefore interpret clause (b)(ii) as its own separate $25,000,000 allowance, which would permit aggregate payments exceeding the source's combined cap. The missing shared-cap dependency is independently operative in the source and is not represented.

I am marking this UNCERTAIN rather than MATERIAL because the missing definition prevents full resolution.
